slowest_experiments.experiment: Trace-automaton ARC live supervisor LOO A/B

summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 3.2 minutes, including 4 compute-bound experiments. Exact certificate proposal corpus at 1.62 minutes and Three-family GGUF accelerator canaries at 1.3 minutes were the longest compute-bound entries. No data available this milestone explains their phase-level duration, and compute-task GPU idle was not flagged.
bottlenecks_identified: Disk-modification-time reconstruction does not provide phase-level timing, so the causes of the longest compute-bound durations cannot be identified.

The GPU report is a global snapshot without task ownership, batch size, model-concurrency, or runner-selection receipts; compute-task efficiency and DualGPURunner eligibility cannot be audited per experiment.
At the monitor snapshot, only one Python inference process was present; the tooling did not expose whether independent questions could be batched.
improvements_suggested: Record monotonic phase timings and task-scoped GPU utilization in each compute-bound artifact.
Record task ownership, batch size, concurrent model count, and selected runner so DualGPURunner eligibility is auditable.
Batch 8-16 questions per forward pass when the workload permits.
Add a GPU-aware scheduler that routes independent single-model tasks to available devices and reserves DualGPURunner for tasks that load 2+ models in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-scoped phase timing and accelerator receipts.
Batch 8-16 questions per forward pass when the workload permits.
Schedule independent single-model work across available devices while recording model count and runner choice.
meta_reflection: The data supports separating accelerator engagement from scheduler capacity: the active device had high utilization, while the locked compute-task idle field remained false. Because timing came from disk modification times and the GPU data is one snapshot, no data available this milestone attributes the slowest tasks to a phase or establishes a multi-model DualGPURunner miss.
